faq.title: Clarity to collaborate and keep work moving.

items.question: How does yapt. teams work as a corporate chat?
items.answer: yapt. teams brings groups, private chats and voice features together for internal company communication. Case discussions add a link to the customer-service or sales conversation, bringing coordination between people closer to the customer context.

items.question: How can people collaborate on a customer-service or sales conversation?
items.answer: A discussion can be started from the customer-service conversation modal. The link preserves the conversation or ticket reference and lets participants consult available information such as contact, company, status and owners, as well as open the original conversation. Each person’s access permissions still apply.

items.question: Can I involve groups and partners?
items.answer: You can involve colleagues and groups enabled to receive case discussions. Partners must be users with authorized company access and participate in permitted spaces. Participation depends on configured membership and permissions; it is not a public room open through a link.

items.question: How does the decision return to customer service?
items.answer: In a linked discussion, a person can review and record the decision as an internal note in customer service, with a reference to the discussion. Closing a discussion organizes the internal work and its outcome. It does not close the ticket or automatically change the customer-service status.

items.question: What helps find information that has already been shared?
items.answer: Global search and in-conversation search help retrieve messages. Threads keep a topic’s replies together, files are available in the conversation and important messages can be saved. Results respect the spaces each person can access.

items.question: Does yapt. teams support voice calls?
items.answer: Audio features support calls in private chats and voice spaces in the Lounge, according to account availability. Presence helps track people’s availability.

items.question: Where do we start?
items.answer: yapt. teams is in Beta. First confirm availability for your company and choose a routine where coordination between people or departments delays work. Your team can organize participants and spaces and work with specialists when needed. Track indicators such as time to get support, handoffs and service continuity.
